subject: Arch deep-dive: SOC2 evidence handoff & timezone-aware scheduling
messages:
From: Samir Jain <samir.jain@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearlinehealth.com
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC2 evidence deep-dive + scheduling (timezone constraints)

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Were ready to schedule the technical deep-dive / architecture review to map SOC 2 evidence owners and confirm encryption & audit log posture. A few constraints on our side: we have engineering folks in PST, CET and IST timezones—best windows are 8:00-11:00 PST or 14:00-17:00 CET.

High-level asks for the session: 
- Walkthrough of environment diagram and where evidence lives (S3/buckets, log sinks, key rotation).
- SSO/IdP flow and token/session lifetimes for audit evidence.
- Audit log retention, export paths, and sample log schema.
- Encryption at rest & envelope key management (KMS/HSM integrations).
- Quick handoff on what artifacts you can provide right away (matrix or sample queries).

Can you propose 2 slots that work for your team and share any pre-reads or evidence template? Wed like a 75-minute session with a 15-minute breakout focused on audit logs.

Participants from our side: me (Samir), Jordan Price (security consultant) and procurement

Thanks,
Samir Jain
Security Program Manager
Clearline Health

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Jain <samir.jain@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 evidence deep-dive + scheduling (timezone constraints)

Hi Samir — great to hear from you. Happy to run this. Proposed slots (we tried to cover the time windows you called out):
- Option A: Tue Oct 5, 10:00 PT / 18:00 CET / Wed 03:30 IST (75 min, with 15 min audit-breakout)
- Option B: Wed Oct 6, 08:30 PT / 16:30 CET / Thu 01:00 IST (75 min, with 15 min audit-breakout)

Attendees Im planning to include: Mina (compliance lead), Soojin (security architect), Logan (solutions/CS). If those slots don't work for your APAC engineers, tell us preferred windows and well shift.

Pre-reads & artifacts: Im attaching a short SOC2 evidence matrix template to speed mapping. Please pre-fill any fields you can (owners, sample artifact path, retention SLA).

[Attachment: SOC2_evidence_matrix_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Agenda (proposed):
1) 0-15m: Introductions & scope (Neha)
2) 15-45m: Environment diagram + components (Soojin)
3) 45-60m: Audit logs deep-dive (Logan)
4) 60-75m: KMS/encryption + next steps (Mina)
5) 75-90m: 15m breakout (audit log queries & owners)

Ill follow up with a calendar invite once you pick a slot. If helpful, I can also include a timezone conversion table for attendees.

Neha Kapoor
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Samir Jain <samir.jain@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@secura.com>, procurement@clearlinehealth.com
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 13:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 evidence deep-dive + scheduling (timezone constraints)

Thanks Neha — Option A (Oct 5) works best for most of the engineering team in the US and EU. A couple of follow-ups before the call:
- Can Soojin include a short note about where KV caches/session tokens are stored (were particularly interested in refresh token lifetimes for forensic timelines).
- For KMS: can Mina confirm whether you use customer-managed keys in Dedicated/Private or the hosted KMS path by default and what rotation cadence you recommend?
- We tried opening the matrix but have a few internal fields to confirm first — Jordan will help with the security-specific columns.

Would you be able to share an environment diagram (redacted is fine) ahead of time? That will speed the session.

Samir

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Jain <samir.jain@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 02:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 evidence deep-dive + scheduling (timezone constraints)

Samir — confirmed, Ive scheduled Option A and sent a calendar invite (link below). I added a timezone conversion table in the invite for CET/PST/IST. Please accept the calendar event so we can finalize attendee list.

Quick answers to your bullets:
- KV/session token storage: we store session tokens in an internal token service (short-lived access tokens + refresh tokens). Soojin will cover TTLs and recommended forensic logging.
- KMS options: Redwood supports both hosted KMS (default) and customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private. Mina will outline tradeoffs and recommended rotation cadence (we typically recommend 90 days for envelope keys; CMKs depend on customer policy).
- Environment diagram: attaching redacted diagram v2.

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_matrix_template.xlsx (previous) + redwood_env_diagram_v2.png

[Attachment: redwood_env_diagram_v2.png (image)]

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=clearline-arch-deepdive-20271005
Drive pre-read: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1q2w3eSOC2_prep_doc

Thanks — looking forward,
Neha
